findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Features in Research Commands

evidence.observation: TODO placeholders indicate missing Phase 5 authorization checking and integrations with EventBus and decision_to_memory

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase authorization checks and EventBus integrations in research_commands.py or track them in the sprint backlog.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes expected functionality and prevents runtime failures or security issues from missing authorization.

findings.title: Unimplemented Database Query in Quality Forecasting

evidence.observation: Stubbed empty list with comment 'TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'

proposed_action.description: Connect quality forecasting logic to actual quality_anomalies database records.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures accurate anomaly reporting in quality forecasting rather than returning an empty set.

findings.title: Missing Model Router Call Log File

evidence.observation: Model router is configured with log_file '/opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl', but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Verify log directory permissions and ensure call_log.jsonl is created and populated on model invocations.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables metric collection, performance auditing, and debugging for router call operations.

findings.title: Direct API Calls Bypass Model Router in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys instead of routing through the model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis tasks through the model router infrastructure rather than invoking provider APIs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains central routing policies, unified logging, fallback handling, and telemetry across all LLM operations.
